question: What covering and inhabitants are found above the fixed covering?
premises: Above the fixed covering lies the will-covering.
In that will-covering dwell Shivas inside the house of the Lord's will.
That city is said to be one.
inference: The will-covering is a single city inhabited by Shivas who abide within the Lord's will.
plain_english: Above the fixed covering is the will-covering. There dwell those Shivas inside the house of the Lord's will, and that city is said to be one.
